name: Medical_reward_bench
description: A dataset for evaluating reward-modeling and preference-based evaluation in medical text generation. It provides human preference or rating data (and/or annotations) intended to train or evaluate reward models that judge medical responses, emphasizing safety and clinical appropriateness. Useful for developing and testing medical alignment, preference modeling, and automated scoring of clinical language outputs.
reputation: Emerging, niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face used by researchers working on medical reward modeling and alignment, with limited broad adoption.
